What gets checked before we pour concrete? On this ADU project, we’re preparing the attached garage footing for inspection. - Footing size and depth help provide the support shown in the structural plans. - Rebar reinforces the concrete, and proper placement keeps it surrounded by enough concrete to protect it. - Epoxied rebar connections tie the new footing into the existing foundation. Where required, a deputy inspector checks the installation before it gets covered. - Anchor bolts secure the garage’s wood framing to the concrete foundation. Their location, spacing, and embedment matter. For homeowners, this is why inspections before the pour are so important. These connections become hidden once the concrete is placed, so this is the time to verify that the work follows the approved plans.
